url.description: HTTP(S) API endpoint that returns JSON with root-level latitude and longitude fields

pollIntervalMs.title: Poll Interval
pollIntervalMs.description: How often to poll the API, in milliseconds

autoTrack.title: Auto Track
autoTrack.description: Center the map on the point after every successful poll

showTrail.title: Show Trail
showTrail.description: Draw a line through recent positions from this API

trailLength.title: Trail Length
trailLength.description: Maximum number of positions kept in the trail

iconUrl.title: Icon URL
iconUrl.description: URL of an image to use for the live point instead of the default circle. Leave empty for the default circle.

useProxy.title: Use Proxy
useProxy.description: Route requests through the Jupyter server proxy to avoid CORS issues.

httpHeaders.title: HTTP Headers
httpHeaders.description: HTTP headers forwarded to the upstream server when useProxy is true.
